The '''Sheer Silence Bubble Generator''' was a [[disruption bubble generator]] manufactured by [[Audio Performance Incorporated]]. Costing three thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], it created a sonic shell that covered a two-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] area in silence.<ref name="ROE" /> Marketed to [[Music/Legends|music]]-lovers, the Sheer Silence was marketed as a "personal portable listening chamber" but soon found favor with [[Commando/Legends|commandos]]<ref name="UA" /> like [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|SpecForce]] [[Infiltrators/Legends|Infiltrators]].<ref name="ROE" />
